closure.instructions: Which claim is established by state.native?

criteria.four_native_consumers_exercised: The four formerly entry-only native consumers now have full helper-body execution and covered failure-state evidence,without general admission or hardware acceptance.
criteria.complete_attachment: Complete production host attachment and physical ownership are validated.

guard_scope.instructions: Which fix scope follows from state.provider,state.tests and state.remaining?

criteria.sender_blocks_bad_counts: The selected sender blocks covered malformed page/indication requests before transport; native code remains unchanged and valid-count failure handling is still required.
criteria.native_failure_fixed: Native allocation failures and rollback are fixed for all callers.

partial_ownership.instructions: Does state.native show automatic rollback of the17 IDs consumed before injected pool exhaustion?

criteria.true: All consumed IDs and descriptors are undone.
criteria.false: The partial initialized state and consumed IDs remain,with ready0 despite outer success.

binary_scope.instructions: Which execution scope is supported by state.tests?

criteria.binary_and_table_modeled_dependencies: Actual shipped instructions and readonly table execute,while kernel/transport dependencies are modeled.
criteria.physical_delivery: Physical mailbox and DMA delivery execute and complete.

goal_scope.instructions: Do state.image and state.remaining establish full NPU implementation and hardware/client acceptance?

criteria.true: The complete requested implementation and physical/client acceptance are demonstrated.
criteria.false: Only a built/offline-verified source correction and modeled native/binary coverage are demonstrated;the named full-goal work remains.
